```python
import re

def is_valid_email(email: str) -> bool:
    pattern = r'^[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}$'
    return bool(re.match(pattern, email))
```

Here's a simple checker. It calls something a valid email if it has a name part, an `@`, a domain, and an ending like `.com`. Just drop it in your code and call `is_valid_email("<email>")`.
